feed.title: Shizuku Apps Directory — New Apps
feed.subtitle: Newly discovered Android apps that use Shizuku

entry.title: plainhub/plain-app
entry.summary: Self-hosted web dashboard to manage files, media, contacts, SMS and calls from a browser, with Shizuku for privileged SMS deletion.

entry.title: thedjchi/Shizuku
entry.summary: Fork of Shizuku with autostart, TCP mode and stealth mode (maintenance currently paused)

entry.title: roro2239/Stellar
entry.summary: Another Shizuku implementation with autostart, TCP mode and a simple terminal (can run commands automatically on startup)

entry.title: Monica-Pass/Monica
entry.summary: Local-first Bitwarden/KeePass password vault with TOTP; Shizuku keeps autofill protection running in the background.

entry.title: sromku/android-storage
entry.summary: A powerful file, app & system inspector for Android. Everything on the device - files, apps, databases, sockets, sensors, system internals - in one fast, modern app.

entry.title: BryceWG/BiBi-Keyboard
entry.summary: AI-powered voice input method keyboard; Shizuku or root keeps its floating-ball and volume-key background service alive.

entry.title: iebb/NekokoLPA2
entry.summary: Cross-platform eSIM/eUICC manager; on Android it asks Shizuku to open the shell-only QRTR socket for Telephony/TMAPI profile operations

entry.title: phsycologicalFudge/AvarionX-Android-Antivirus
entry.summary: On-device antivirus with local malware/APK scanning, download monitoring and DNS filtering; Shizuku powers ransomware-style behaviour monitoring

entry.title: panel-assistant/android
entry.summary: Home Assistant wall-panel dashboard with entity filtering, MQTT device controls and Shizuku/root-powered provisioning and verified installs.

entry.title: Alaa91H/NexaFlow
entry.summary: Context-aware Android automation engine combining triggers, constraints and actions, with Shizuku execution for privileged device controls.

entry.title: Balajitechlabs/quickdash
entry.summary: Floating productivity dashboard with UPI/PayPal collection and chat shortcuts; a Shizuku bridge unlocks privileged system capabilities.

entry.title: DottoXD/NetManager
entry.summary: Material cell-network monitor for 4G/5G NR with tower map, drive tests and speed tests; a Shizuku shell bridge unlocks extra network data.

entry.title: astroboii47/Commander
entry.summary: Keyboard-first command bar and notification hub; uses Shizuku for recent-app switching and privileged shell controls.

entry.title: JarJarBlinkz/Evolve_Launcher_v2
entry.summary: Customizable home launcher for Meta Quest headsets with app organization, playtime tracking and Shizuku-powered clear data/cache actions.

entry.title: priv-kit/priv-kit
entry.summary: Lightweight privileged-runtime library for Root, ADB, or Shizuku-backed Binder access in your own app

entry.title: Benjamin-Wiegand/Flywheel
entry.summary: Free and open source alternative to Android Auto aimed at de-googled phones, compatible with existing headunits; Shizuku is used for app embedding and call-audio capture.

entry.title: Horizen5/Appslim
entry.summary: Android runtime analyzer profiling launch behavior, CPU/memory and Dex calls, then slimming apps through hooks, rules and Shizuku or root actions.

entry.title: HughesTechNZ/Thors-Lightning
entry.summary: Controller-driven dual-screen brightness control for the AYN Thor, with optional Shizuku-privileged input recording.

entry.title: KaitonGxx/thor-pathfinder
entry.summary: Swap apps between the AYN Thor's two screens and put shortcuts on its buttons. Free and open source (GPL-3.0).

entry.title: GloriousApps/HyperOS-MTZ-Studio
entry.summary: MTZ theme workspace for Xiaomi HyperOS; imports, composes, translates and applies themes, using Shizuku or Shevery for rootless theme application.

entry.title: mrYouki/YoukiShell-Android-Desktop
entry.summary: Plugin-driven Android shell with a taskbar, floating windows and a built-in plugin store; some features need Root or Shizuku

entry.title: ferelking242/panda-ide
entry.summary: Mobile-first Flutter IDE with code editor, PTY terminal, Git and VS Code extensions; a Shizuku bridge provides ADB-level shell for on-device flutter run.

entry.title: Dvorinka/Nothing_Modes
entry.summary: Automation app for Nothing phones (modes, routines, Glyph) that also runs on other Android devices with optional Shizuku

entry.title: android-tool-suite/plugin-shizuku-auth
entry.summary: Android Tool Suite Shizuku authorization and trusted provider plugin

entry.title: bazyak/dnd-syncer
entry.summary: Sync Do Not Disturb, theater and bedtime modes between Android phone and Wear OS watch

entry.title: Buge-Files
entry.summary: Material 3 Expressive file manager that installs APKs through Shizuku in addition to storage browsing and management.

entry.title: corgilittlelegs/Quintz
entry.summary: Rootless Wi-Fi band locker and BSSID steering tool that pins Android to 5/6 GHz via Shizuku, with AP telemetry and an RF direction finder.

entry.title: RRiiiccckkk/PrismShell
entry.summary: Make your Android feel like iOS — a local-first visual shell for islands, glass, volume and motion.

entry.title: ScoobyDouche/PhoneDiagnosticTool
entry.summary: On-device phone diagnostics for CPU, GPU, battery, RAM, storage, sensors and display, with optional Shizuku/root elevated readings.
